task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the right arm to grab the smooth red can and place in the basket with arched black grip, lift the basket with arched black grip with another arm.
